input_feature_policy: Only the selected request_en and selected A or B caption text are model/scorer inputs.
Source code truth and sufficient caption information are distinct; caption insufficiency masks only proposed loss, not underlying function-truth evaluation denominator.
A/B/KO display/nearvariants/aliases/helper lineage remain the same three parents and whole source families.

mask_policy_proposed_only.policy: Positive needs all material requested behavior visible in caption plus model-visible request scope. Negative may be eligible if a decisive required-clause contradiction is visible; otherwise zero even when full code proves failure. Unknown code/caption never becomes negative automatically.

metadata_budget.counter: Independent ASCII byte syntax counter mirrors published identifier-boundary recipe, without runtime Normalize/Validate/Features calls. Requests have no camelcase boundaries.

pair_eligibility_proposed_only.limit: Current pair-ranking72 may include zero-BCE-weight endpoints in known-truth parents. Proposed weight zero here does not implement pair exclusion. Before future use, a caller/pair-plan must enforce explicit caption endpoint eligibility, or conservatively exclude a parent with insufficient endpoints. No retroactive invalidation or reinterpretation of72 results is made.

paired_experiment_limits: A caption-only causal comparison must hold a separately frozen common mask/weights fixed, e.g. intersection, rather than silently change the loss cohort.
The proposed intersection here has no eligible positive from this slice; do not call that alone a ready positive/pair-learning dataset.
Per-arm mask use changes both caption information and supervision coverage and must be explicitly treated as such; no such experiment runs here.
All source-level acceptable sets and no_answer/unknown denominators must be preserved in later evaluation, regardless of loss masks; masks cannot improve reported utility by deleting hard rows.
